name: thimble
description: thimble for Claude Code: the `thimble` command reads and queries any files and keeps the code, inputs and source rows behind every value. Each card Claude saves is drawn under its reply and opens in a detail view that keeps the chat going; each citation opens the rows it cites. After each turn an observer leaves notes for Claude, lights v when another view would help, and marks the terms the person may not know.

observer.title: Observer
observer.description: After each turn of work, a side agent reads the answer and the objects behind it: it leaves notes for Claude, lights v when another view would help, and marks the terms you may not know.

prompts.title: Prompts
prompts.description: Versions of the texts thimble's models read, in place of the defaults: feature:version pairs separated by commas, such as forms:principles. `thimble prompts` lists them. The THIMBLE_PROMPTS environment variable, when set, wins. Empty: the defaults.
